content: CRAN canonical pattern for Suggests-guarded rendering: use requireNamespace('pkg', quietly=TRUE) for capability checks. For rmarkdown/knitr (already in EventStudy Suggests): stop() with install.packages hint if missing (existing pattern in generate_report()). For PDF: guard separately with Sys.which check AND optional tinytex check — never stop() unconditionally, instead return a message/warning + skip PDF. For Word: pandoc handles docx without extra R packages so only requireNamespace('rmarkdown') needed. R-pkgs.org recommends: mandatory → stop(); degradable → if(requireNamespace) ... else fallback. The offline-first report spec means all four guards must degrade gracefully to 'format skipped' rather than stop().
